name: Camping Stubai
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Stubai is located in Neustift im Stubaital. The facility has parcelled pitches for various vehicle types. The sanitary facilities are up to date. A small supermarket and a restaurant are available on site. The Stubaital is a popular destination for mountain sports enthusiasts. In summer, countless hiking trails invite you to go on tours. In winter, the nearby Stubaier Gletscher ski area attracts visitors with reliable snow conditions.
